understanding.goal_understanding: Place all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked with '+' at the same time; a level is only won when every '+' is occupied simultaneously, and the overall game is won after clearing all levels within the step limits.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were limited by a per-level step budget. MOVE_* would move the currently selected piece one tile in that direction unless blocked by walls/obstacles or other immovable tiles. CLICK selected/teleported the active selectable piece to a specified coordinate if that destination was valid/unblocked; invalid targets (walls/blocked squares/out of bounds) caused no movement. Success required correctly selecting between multiple pieces and positioning them on separate goal tiles without blocking each other.

understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were limited by a per-level step budget. MOVE_* would move the currently selected piece one tile in that direction unless blocked by walls/obstacles or other immovable tiles. CLICK selected/teleported the active selectable piece to a specified coordinate if that destination was valid/unblocked; invalid targets (walls/blocked squares/out of bounds) caused no movement. Success required correctly selecting between multiple pieces and positioning them on separate goal tiles without blocking each other.
